evidence.claim: The Reuben Sale House is a brick landmark on Smith Lane near La Grange, built around 1833.
evidence.quote: The Reuben Sale House, at 3700 Smith Lane in Oldham County, Kentucky near La Grange, was built around 1833.

evidence.claim: Its two stories have four bays, with Flemish-bond brickwork on the front.
evidence.quote: It is a two-story, single-pile brick house with four bays and Flemish bond brickwork on its front facade.

evidence.claim: A double-crib log barn forms a second contributing building in its National Register designation, recorded in 1982.
evidence.quote: A " fine double-crib log barn" is a second contributing building.

evidence.claim: Bethlehem lies across the Ohio River from Oldham County, in Indiana.
evidence.quote: Bethlehem is located along the Ohio River, close to the border with Jefferson County, Indiana, and across the Ohio River from Oldham County, Kentucky.

evidence.claim: Its steamboat and ferry landing, together with roads to New Washington and Lexington, once made it a transportation center.
evidence.quote: Early in its history, Bethlehem had a steamboat and ferry landing, and with its road to New Washington and Lexington, Indiana Bethlehem became a major transportation center.

evidence.claim: By 1900, ferry service had ended.
evidence.quote: Census records show a loss in population from 1880 to 1900. By then Bethlehem no longer offered ferry service.

evidence.claim: The 1937 Ohio River flood destroyed much of the town’s historical record.
evidence.quote: Much of Bethlehem's history was destroyed by the Ohio River flood of 1937.

evidence.claim: A later preservation effort began with Historic Bethlehem Inc. in 1993, which converted the old elementary school into a community center and started the Autumn on the River festival.
evidence.quote: In 1993 Historic Bethlehem Inc. was founded. It turned the old elementary school into a community center (today's children attend school in New Washington), and started the annual Autumn on the River festival.

evidence.claim: Platted in 1812, the community was laid out in a rectangle of 124 lots.
evidence.quote: platted the community in 1812.  It was laid out in 124 lots in a rectangular manner.
